family.schneider-tower-at.description: Compact ATs with a separate CPU card and different floppy, hard disk and memory configurations.
family.schneider-tower-at.history: Schneider's Tower AT range brought AT compatibility to a compact modular case in 1988. The manual covers the 201, 202 and 220; later variants expanded storage and memory. Contemporary reviews highlighted the working package with MS-DOS and Microsoft Works. Commercial names alone cannot identify each specimen's board revision or BIOS.
